description: COVID-GM-RESCORE-02 imports:3 diagnostic -- the labelled non-scoring probe paired with covid_gm_rescore_v2, verbatim from the v1 diagnostic design. RESCORE-01 measured that tripling imports lifts P(takeoff) from 0.80 to 1.0 and lands H1 with a tight envelope: ignition, not transmission size, is the dominant residual on the held-out leg. Under the post-DP-era engine (service-door-drop, propensity, defiant-escalation machinery all shipped since) this probe re-measures whether the ignition tail is still the residual class.
split_role_note: Same declaration as the scoring design: this file scores nothing -- it is a labelled diagnostic on the split's held-out hull, declared here and verified against the split at load.

cell_conditioning.note: Identical to covid_gm_rescore_v2 except the imports axis: 3 explicit passenger seeds at epoch 0, infection_age_days 0.0 each (the probe's one deviation from the record, declared in the imports field). All other conditioning verbatim from the scoring design.

arms.note: Baseline arm only (empty overrides; the shipped hand line). The probe is an import-count question, not a hand-arm question.

cells_note: 1 Theta x 1 arm x 50 seeds = 50 cells; seeds identical to the scoring design's anchor row so the delta pairs on (theta, seed).

metrics: P(takeoff >=10 recorded onsets) at 3 imports vs the scoring design's 1-import anchor row
campaign_positives median + q05-q95 vs H1's 128, takeoff-conditional positives, asymptomatic_share -- same reads as the scoring readout
seed-paired delta vs the scoring row on (theta 2.37e11, seed): does tripling imports move P(takeoff) materially, and does the conditional count move with it
v2-vs-v1 on the probe itself: whether the v1 rescue (P(takeoff) 1.0, positives median 113 [89, 129]) still holds under drift
freeze.verdict_grammar: Diagnostic readout only -- no verdict class. 'imports rescue' = P(takeoff) lifts materially AND the takeoff-conditional campaign_positives median moves toward 128; 'ignition fixed, size still wrong' = takeoff up but positives stay low; 'regime dead' = P(takeoff) ~ 0 even at 3 imports.

admissibility.note: Labelled diagnostic, not a scoring row: GM's record declares one import and the as-declared cell is the scoring row; this cell measures the import-count sensitivity around it.
audit_invariants: delivery.hand_reservoir_mode echoes hygiene_cycle on every payload.
delivery.caregiver resolved block present on every payload.
seed_ring.seed_spec.count == 3 (the probe) with infection_age_days 0.0 and role passenger; seeded_count == 3.
cell pairing to the scoring rows keyed on (theta, seed) -- the same seeds in both files.
admissibility.report_immediately_if: P(takeoff) does not lift materially vs the scoring anchor row (the v1 import-rescue died under drift -- the ignition defect moved mechanism class) or the positives median lands outside the v1 envelope [89, 129] in the downward direction.

execution.platform: Same campaigns/ path as the scoring design -- the imports3_hygiene block of campaigns/covid/gm_rescore_02/ -- submitted only on the author's go-ahead after the scoring canary, per the campaign gate.
